tasks.name: Síntesis JIT de Herramienta Zombie Hunter
tasks.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/zombie_code.py
import sys
import subprocess

def scan_zombies():
    res = subprocess.run(['ps', '-eo', 'pid,stat,comm'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    zombies = [l for l in res.stdout.splitlines() if len(l.split()) >= 2 and 'Z' in l.split()[1]]
    print(f'Procesos Zombie Detectados: {len(zombies)}')
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(scan_zombies())
EOF
superagent jit create --name "zombie_hunter" --desc "Escáner ultrarrápido de procesos zombie y huérfanos" --file /tmp/zombie_code.py
rm -f /tmp/zombie_code.py
